project.name: LEADGEN
project.purpose: Lead generation, website auditing, PDF reporting, and outreach operations.
project.status: Phase 2 CLOSED — CONDITIONAL GO (commit 17cffe5). Phase 3 Workstream A complete locally; Workstream B is next.

architecture.browser_proxy: auditor/auditor/browser/proxy.py — lifecycle-bound HTTP/CONNECT policy proxy; enforces IP policy at TCP-connection time; started/stopped inside BrowserProvider._capture_with_playwright(); no new dependencies
architecture.database: PostgreSQL models in backend/app/models.py; additive audit_lifecycle migration in backend/migrations/v6_1_0_audit_lifecycle.sql

data_flow: optional browser capture when BROWSER_ENABLED=true with raw-vs-rendered annotation
isolated structured factor results plus mapped Audit columns and audit_lifecycle
critical_rules: Runtime code is authoritative; record documentation drift explicitly.
Preserve existing lead, campaign, CRM, outreach, and scraping behavior unless the task authorizes a change.
Use factor_registry.json for all audit-factor changes.
Browser evidence is disabled by default and never launches at import time.
A browser failure must never affect any of the 62 factor results.
known_issues: DOCUMENTATION_DRIFT: archived prose says 55 factors; runtime builds 62.
LIMITATION: Browser evidence is disabled by default; enabled only when BROWSER_ENABLED=true.
LIMITATION: HTTP request duration is not TTFB or Core Web Vitals.
LIMITATION: Multi-page browser crawl and full Core Web Vitals are deferred to Phase 3.

FINDING F1 (low severity): proxy relay (_relay in browser/proxy.py) has only a 30-second idle timeout; no absolute wall-clock cap or byte limit on relay sessions. Blast radius is zero when BROWSER_ENABLED=false.

FINDING F2 (low severity): _handle_plain_http in browser/proxy.py uses rpartition(':') to split host:port; a bare IPv6 literal without brackets would be mis-parsed. Chromium sends well-formed requests so not exploitable in practice, but parse failure is silent.
current_phase: Phase 3 — Workstream A complete and verification-gated; Workstream B remains pending.
next_action: Implement WS-B local Core Web Vitals only after Workstream A report; preserve the 62-factor score and existing browser security boundary.
